description: This PHP class defines an import map for CSV files in SuiteCRM. It extends another import map class, ImportMapOther, and specifies properties related to CSV import configuration such as the delimiter and enclosure characters.

classes.name: ImportMapCsv
classes.description: A class representing the mapping configuration for CSV import, extending ImportMapOther, with properties for CSV-specific settings.

methods.name: ImportMapCsv::__construct
methods.description: Default constructor to initialize import map properties; inherited from parent class.
